tests.name: serializer_inlining_deep_dump_array
tests.intent: Probes serialization dump of a deeply nested array structure, exercising the recursive serializer helper path affected by inline conditions.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_deep_dump_object
tests.intent: Probes serialization dump of deeply nested objects, testing stack frame usage and serializer helpers like put_literal_indent.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_empty_containers
tests.intent: Probes serialization of empty nested arrays and objects to ensure helper functions handle boundary nesting correctly.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_string_buffering
tests.intent: Probes strings with numerous escape sequences within deep structures to exercise reserve_string_buffer and emit_pending helpers.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_mixed_types_walk
tests.intent: Probes dumping objects and arrays containing mixed data types (booleans, floats, null, strings) at varying depths.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_stream_output
tests.intent: Probes writing a deeply nested json object into an std::ostream, exercising serialization helpers via stream operators.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_to_string_api
tests.intent: Probes nlohmann::to_string with deeply nested JSON values to ensure internal serializer helpers execute properly.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_format_as_api
tests.intent: Probes nlohmann::format_as ADL helper with basic_json objects to ensure correct interaction with serializers.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_indentation_widths
tests.intent: Probes serialization with various indent widths (0, 1, 4, -1) on a moderately nested structure to test put_indent and put_literal_indent.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_comparison_operators
tests.intent: Probes comparison operators (operator!=, operator<) which are tied via public API pathways to serializer helpers.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_max_depth_limit
tests.intent: Probes behavior right at and beyond the recursion depth limit to verify correct exception throwing vs successful serialization.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_wide_containers
tests.intent: Probes wide arrays and objects containing many elements at multiple levels to test buffer reservation and element dumping.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_utf8_characters
tests.intent: Probes serialization of complex unicode strings within nested structures to ensure character escaping and buffer management work smoothly.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_binary_types
tests.intent: Probes serialization of binary/byte container types nested inside arrays and objects.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_ordered_json
tests.intent: Probes ordered_json serialization to ensure serializer helpers apply identically to specialized basic_json subclasses.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_patch_apply
tests.intent: Probes json patch application and subsequent dumping, exercising full roundtrip serialization pathways.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_merge_patch
tests.intent: Probes json merge patch application and output serialization.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_json_pointer
tests.intent: Probes json_pointer evaluation and subsequent value serialization.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_sax_dump_integration
tests.intent: Probes serialization combined with custom SAX parsing and generation to verify event handler consistency.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_huge_number_serialization
tests.intent: Probes serialization of extreme numeric values (very large floats and integers) inside nested arrays.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises reserve_string_buffer and emit_pending by serializing a deeply nested object containing strings with numerous unicode escape sequences requiring 13+ bytes buffer space per write.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises reserve_string_buffer with extremely long strings containing consecutive unicode escapes within arrays, triggering the buffer capacity check inside serializer helpers.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises emit_pending and reserve_string_buffer under high-volume string serialization within nested containers with pretty-printing enabled.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises reserve_string_buffer and emit_pending with control characters requiring hex representation in strings deeply embedded in json arrays.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises serializer string buffer management by serializing highly nested objects whose keys and string values both contain characters needing unicode escaping.

tests.name: serializer_inlining_sax_dump_integration_fixed
tests.intent: Probes serialization combined with custom SAX parsing and generation to verify event handler consistency.
